notes: Second-pass checker. Crisis routes verified: Samaritans 116 123 free any time and NHS 111 mental health option via search of NHS 'Help for suicidal thoughts' page plus trust pages; 999 for immediate danger. NHS fluoxetine pages disagree on whether thoughts of self-harm are 999/A&E (side-effects page) or 111 (main page); text uses the SSRI page route (GP or hospital straight away, 999 if in immediate danger). Children's age: NHS pages disagree (8 vs 5); both stated. Alcohol: NHS pages differ; both stated. Common side effects were removed because no search returned them: the common list is empty; a human or later pass should retrieve the NHS common side effects and restore it. Search summaries blend pages; URL attribution for several claims is to the page the summary named. Diabetes caution rests on a Sheffield Children's leaflet (cataplexy), weaker than an NHS medicines page. Summary clause 'available only on prescription' is textbook/status, not retrieved text.
